newsitem.title: MEXICO: Modelo in U.S. distribution accord.
newsitem.headline: Modelo in U.S. distribution accord.

text.p: Mexican beer-maker Grupo Modelo S.A. said on Thursday that it signed an accord granting exclusive distribution rights for its products in the United States to Barton Beers, Ltd and Gambrinus Company.
"Both companies will have exclusive rights to distribute our beers in the United States until the year 2006," Modelo said in a statement.

The company added that it is finishing a new beer factory in the central state of Zacatecas. It said the factory, slated to open in 1997, will produce at first only the company's brand leader Corona. At a later date it will also produce other brands.
Modelo is Mexico's biggest brewer. Its brands include Corona, Victoria, Negra Modelo, Modelo Especial and Pacifico.
